optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id, st.s_state, grouping(st.s_state) AS g_state,
       avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM store_sales AS ss
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999) AS d
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics
      WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
        AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary') AS cd
  ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state = 'TN') AS st
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, st.s_state)
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, st.s_state
LIMIT 100
